# TaskSetRegs

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Writes the user registers of a faulted or suspended task.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0C` SVC_MANAGETASK | `MNGTASK_SET_REGS (8)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err TaskSetRegs(Handle h, const TaskRegs *in);
```

**Registers:** `(task, in) -> r0 status`

Privileged bits in `in->flags` are ignored, the task always resumes in user mode with interrupts enabled.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | Task handle with PERM_CNTL. |
| `in` | in | New register values. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BUSY`](../errors.md#err_busy) | The task is running, or suspended inside a blocking call. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `in->pc` is misaligned for the instruction set in `in->flags`. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The task has exited. |
| [`ERR_BADPTR`](../errors.md#err_badptr) | `in` is not readable memory. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `h` is not a task. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `h` lacks PERM_CNTL. |
